cohort: The study included 388 infants weighing up to 1,800g at birth, with a median gestational age of 31.6 weeks and median birth weight of 1,429g, from five Brazilian neonatal units.
finding: Skin-to-skin contact, especially averaging > 149.6 min/day, was strongly associated with higher rates of exclusive breastfeeding at hospital discharge for preterm infants weighing 1,125g-1,655g at birth, particularly those with lower severity scores.
birth_weight: Eligible for <= 1,800g; median 1,429g (IQR 1,202-1,610g); key findings for 1,125g-1,655g
